---
title: "Blog"
description: "Technical articles, tutorials, and notes on data science and machine learning."
listing:
  contents: "*.qmd"
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: [title, description, categories]
  max-description-length: 300
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories, author]
  field-display-names:
    categories: 'Topics'
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Short articles, tutorials, and notes on statistics, machine learning, and software engineering.

To publish a new post, drop a single `.qmd` file into the `blog/` folder; see `PUBLISHING.md` at the repository root for the front-matter fields to use. It will appear above automatically the next time the site is rendered, no other edit required.
